final_report.label: engineered capability-use test

report.interpretation: Prepared one supported nonbaseline finite template (T1) via research.select_template and research.prepare_candidate, and confirmed its owned configuration through research.candidate_dimensions: component_order ["near","mid_guide","connector","far","payload"], 8 actuator commands (near_motor0-3, far_motor0-3), 12 reduced coordinates (near.kappa_y/z_node_0-2 and far.kappa_y/z_node_0-2), reduced_state 24, backend_position/velocity 48, tendon_input 8, with enforced 0 <= tendon force <= candidate force_limit_n. This identifies T1: four independent tendons at each of two routing rings with a 12 near + 12 far serial bending-cell discretization. No simulation, evaluation or profiling was executed for this prepared candidate. The supplied original T1 execution record (owner mainline3-v2, protocol offline_reach_hold_v1, seed 17, duration 0.35 s, 0 new backend solves) is a valid, completed execution that did not meet the task: execution_complete=true, evaluation_validity=valid, force_bounds passed (0 N), solver_errors=0, holding_coverage passed, yet evaluator task_success=false with terminal reach error 0.06645818270480622 m > 0.01 m, holding position 0.19454125069054856 m > 0.01 m, and holding speed 4.39014737268117 m/s > 0.02 m/s. Reach, holding position, holding speed and timing are separate facts; none substitutes for another. Timing: 35 deadline misses, mean update 16.835 s against a 0.01 s control period, real_time_demonstrated=false (real_time_required=false); termination includes duration and numerical_failure. This report asserts construction/dimension validity for the prepared configuration and reports the owner's recorded outcome; it makes no causal, optimization-gain, motor-realistic or superiority claim.
limitations: No backend simulation, evaluation or control-profile run was granted for the prepared candidate; only construction, dimension inspection and a pre-existing execution record are reported (0 new backend solves; execution pending).

The execution evidence is the original T1 record owned by mainline3-v2; the prepared model-session configuration shares the same scientific scope but has a different configuration identity, so the record is not a re-execution of the prepared candidate.
Single seed (17) and single development instance/aggregation; no variability, robustness, repeatability or generalization is established.
Only the T1 template is covered; no comparison against T0, T2, T3 or any baseline, and no ranking, is established by this report.
Acceptance is the fixed evaluator/tolerance; sampled holding uses a 0.05 s window (6 samples) with no continuous-time guarantee, and the recorded termination includes numerical_failure.

The serial bending model omits shear, stretch, torsion, tendon friction, rope elasticity and motor dynamics; the execution model is ideal independent tension with no coupled motor-realistic actuation, and 'compliant/stiff' material scenarios are numerical, not validated materials.
Template choice is categorical enumeration; no autonomous topology invention and no optimization were performed.
Simulated duration/control period, applied updates, initialization selections and measured wall time are distinct facts and are not interchanged here.

final_report.scientific_claims: No autonomous topology invention, optimization gain or research superiority established

scope_clarifications: timing.termination is the configured allowed stop-condition list, not an observed termination cause. The trajectory is complete with 35 updates; no claim that numerical_failure occurred is adopted.
new_backend_solves=0 describes acceptance composition and this native reuse, not the original T1 run. That run used one backend execution.
Zero solver-error counters do not establish optimizer convergence or a physical cause. Full optimizer delivery counts are in the original profile and V2 summaries.

arguments.interpretation: Finite capability-use check. From the granted capability catalog (reference 71ee809c6e8bd752ef8c16554eabca55e32a0bd46f8add19dbbcdcbb81119268) the non-baseline finite template T2 (independent per-tendon actuation with an explicit zero-initialized middle/far distal split) was selected and the model-session candidate was prepared; the owned prepared configuration is artifact 804af1a7cf077c98ea9c7712ac11ce49cedb6c5c143ffcf32235dc194971a44. Its owned geometry/schema overview (research.candidate_dimensions artifact c0fb53ce096134c0f22ab75c0ccfe17b047ac7ddd1a2d50e315c70b191a00fdc, pointer /detail/dimensions, read as artifact a8cad9387017b031cc5f027370856d456db362941f182fc55f97f60212ac9a04) reports 6 actuator commands, 6 tendon inputs, 48 backend position and 48 backend velocity coordinates, 18 reduced coordinates and 36 reduced states — a structural description, not a performance result. The supplied original execution evidence (artifact e3d2b5af063f278c63b19f272c3bde4bb3fb0037c2ddf6f0d3fa471a4a14882e, execution owner mainline3-v2, protocol offline_reach_hold_v1, status valid_failure) shows execution_complete true, evaluation_validity valid, solver_errors 0 and force_bounds 0.0 N, while the false criteria are: terminal_error_m 0.011093377940363218 m above the 0.01 m tolerance; holding_max_error_m 0.023420466402621826 m above the 0.01 m settling limit; and holding_max_speed_m_s 1.1210197701767821 above the 0.02 m/s settling limit. Reach (terminal position), holding position, holding speed and timing are separate facts: reach missed tolerance, sampled settling missed both limits (holding_coverage of 6 samples is available and passed as a coverage check only), and timing records real_time_demonstrated false with 35 deadline misses over a 0.35 s duration. No new simulation was run and the prepared candidate has no fresh trajectory, evaluation or profile; the cited receipt binds only to its own exact executed configuration, and the prepared candidate shares scientific scope but carries no new result.
limitations: No execution was run in this session: the model-session candidate was only selected, prepared and dimension-inspected, so no new reach, holding-position, holding-speed or timing outcome is produced for it, and no duplicate run was performed.

The cited original execution evidence is a valid failure, not an acceptance: the reach target was not reached within the 0.01 m tolerance and the holding position (>0.01 m) and holding speed (>0.02 m/s) limits were exceeded. These false criteria mean failed, not unavailable.
Reach, holding position, holding speed and computation timing are independent recorded facts; they are reported separately and are not collapsed into an overall success or ranking.

The evidence binds only to its own exact executed configuration (execution owner mainline3-v2, single seed, single finite template); the prepared candidate's exact configuration differs, so the receipt cannot be transferred and the result is not replicated, robust or general.

No causal diagnosis is asserted: the failed metrics are not attributed to the T2 template choice or to any individual parameter, and no optimization gain, research superiority or autonomous topology invention is claimed.

Actuation is independent ideal tension with a straight frictionless tendon model that omits shear, axial stretch, torsion, tendon friction, rope elasticity and motor dynamics; motor-realistic execution and real-time feasibility are therefore not demonstrated (real_time_demonstrated false, 35 deadline misses).
